permutationLabel: Caecal volvulus (surgery, not endoscopy), woman of reproductive age
summary: 44-year-old woman, 24 h colicky pain, distension and vomiting; CT: caecum 11 cm in the left upper quadrant with a whirl sign, no ischaemia.

inputs.hpi: 24 hours of colicky central and right-sided abdominal pain, then rapidly increasing distension and vomiting; no flatus since this morning. LMP 3 weeks ago. No previous episodes.

exam.abdomen: Asymmetric distension, tympanic mass in the left upper abdomen, mild tenderness, no peritonism.

imaging.name: CT abdomen/pelvis with IV contrast
imaging.result: Caecal volvulus: caecum 11 cm displaced to the left upper quadrant with a whirl sign of the ileocolic mesentery. Preserved wall enhancement, no pneumatosis, no free gas.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Caecal volvulus
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Caecal volvulus without ischaemia — urgent operation: right hemicolectomy (ileocolic resection) with primary anastomosis. Endoscopic reduction is not appropriate.

socratesAnswers.site: Central and right side, now distended

mustInclude.note: Woman of reproductive age before CT and theatre.
ASCRS 2021: operative management (resection) for caecal volvulus.
mustInclude.knownGapNote: Web: No right hemicolectomy/ileocaecal resection in any output; the volvulus variant reuses the generic bowel-obstruction steps.
mustInclude.proposedFix: Separate caecal-volvulus variant with right hemicolectomy/ileocaecal resection (ASCRS 2021).

mustExclude.note: ASCRS 2021: endoscopic reduction of caecal volvulus is not recommended.

guideline.name: ASCRS clinical practice guidelines — colonic volvulus and acute colonic pseudo-obstruction
guideline.section: Sigmoid volvulus: endoscopic detorsion without peritonitis/ischaemia, then sigmoid colectomy during the same admission; emergency resection for gangrene/perforation; caecal volvulus: operative management, endoscopic reduction not recommended
guideline.citation: Alavi K, Poylin V, Davids JS, et al. The American Society of Colon and Rectal Surgeons clinical practice guidelines for the management of colonic volvulus and acute colonic pseudo-obstruction. Dis Colon Rectum. 2021;64:1046–57.

guideline.name: NICE NG126 — ectopic pregnancy and miscarriage: diagnosis and initial management
guideline.section: Pregnancy test in every woman of reproductive age with abdominal pain; transvaginal ultrasound; immediate referral if haemodynamically unstable; surgical management of ruptured ectopic; anti-D
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Ectopic pregnancy and miscarriage: diagnosis and initial management. NICE guideline NG126, 2019 (updated 2023).

rationale: Permutation: site. Caecal volvulus is treated by resection (ASCRS 2021), not endoscopic reduction; a pregnancy test is needed before CT and theatre.
